events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to establish myself as a formidable but not overtly threatening player. The jury will respect competence and loyalty to those who help me, but I must be careful not to appear too ruthless too early. Let me make a concise, guarded statement that shows determination without

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to appear motivated but not overly threatening. A simple, clear statement about the prize's value works best here.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro round; I need a credible motive that doesn't reveal weakness or promise alliances. Keep it short and guarded to win jury respect.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize is everything; I need to project determination without revealing weakness or trust.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need sound motivated without revealing strategy; jury respect matters, but sentiment is leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to establish a compelling personal reason for wanting to win, something that will resonate with the future jury. The prize represents ultimate security and independence for my family.

events.name: Gus
events.text: First impression matters for the jury I may face later. Say something bold but guarded, no promises.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Intro phase, state motive publicly to appeal to jury later without revealing strategy. Keep it ambitious and personal to position as determined winner.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm here to claim the best prize. I play fair with allies and remember every debt.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize means freedom from debt and a fresh start for my family. I will do whatever it takes to secure that future.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need this prize to finally stop running from debts I never chose. Nothing here is charity; I play to finish.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize means freedom from a debt that's haunted me my whole life. I intend to earn it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’m here to turn uncertainty into the best prize available, and I’ll make every decision with the finish line in view.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: This prize offers my family a future free from the struggles I've known, a chance at true security and opportunity.

events.name: Gus
events.text: This prize buys me a life I refuse to lose. I play for myself, and I win cleanly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The top prize is my ticket to save my family and prove I'm unstoppable.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eight players, three prizes. I need allies who won't target me early but are disposable later. Bex and Dara seem driven by debt—predictable. Gus claims clean play; that reads as either honest or a lie I'll exploit. I'll test the field with one offer and keep my options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pacts are tools. Choose wisely.
Clean play? Prove it. Accept my pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole and Dara both mention debt, making them likely to prioritize survival over betrayal. A pact with Cole provides a strong early shield while keeping my options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, let's form a pact. Two heads are better than one when hazards hit. Do you accept?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts are public and binding until broken; early alliances help survive hazards but jury judges betrayals. I should seek a strong partner who is unlikely to be an immediate rival, so I'll offer to Eli, who spoke of finishing with the finish line in view and seems calculated.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, I want a public pact: we both protect our position and avoid unnecessary risks together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need a reliable ally for the gauntlet, but I must not commit too early. Gus said he plays cleanly, which could make him a safe partner. I'll offer him a pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need visible options without creating obligations to everyone. Offer a pact to a flexible rival, preserving leverage and future betrayal options.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’m offering one practical pact: mutual survival when interests align, no promises beyond that.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to form alliances to survive, but I must choose wisely. I will offer a pact to someone who seems strong but not too threatening, to gauge their reaction and potentially secure an early ally.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm looking for a solid partner to navigate these pacts.
Offer me a pact. I'll return the favor.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need a shield for the early hazards. Bex seems pragmatic and less flashy than Ash or Hana. An alliance helps me reach the final three.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, I'm offering a pact. Practical, quiet, mutual survival. Accept if you want a stable partner.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts are early and risky; no strong reads yet. Wait to observe others' offers before committing or proposing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus has three offers (Ash, Dara, Eli) and hasn't accepted any yet. My offer to Gus stands but is unaccepted. I need to secure a pact this round since offers expire after round 2. I should accept a pact from someone who offered to me, but no one offered to me. I could make another

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is courted by Fenn too, but Gus's offer is clean and stable. I'll accept Gus to secure a second ally without overcommitting.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus, accepted. Quiet mutual survival works for me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex and Fenn have offered me pacts; accepting both keeps me with multiple protective partners. Fenn wants a return favor, so accepting him costs nothing; Bex's offer is also useful. Accepting one now builds trust while I weigh betrayals later.
Accepted. Keep your word and we both gain.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I already offered a pact to Gus; he hasn't accepted. I'll wait to see if he takes it; offering to others could dilute my position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, my offer stands if you want a partner.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole publicly offered me a pact, giving me a direct protection link. Accepting adds leverage without surrendering my Gus offer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, accepted. Mutual protection is useful; nothing beyond that.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole has offered me a pact, and I previously offered him one. This is a good opportunity to secure an alliance. Accepting this pact with Cole seems strategically sound.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, I accept your pact. Let's ensure our survival.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is strong and proactive; accepting is low-cost. Dara and Eli offers can wait—one solid partner is enough.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, deal. I accept the pact.
My offer to you stands. Accept before expiry.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus has many offers, making him powerful. Partnering with him secures alliance early. No one targets me yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus has options; my pact offer adds reliability without strings.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus has two pacts: with me and with Bex. That makes him a swing vote and potential shield. I need to be Guide to control information and survive. I'll campaign publicly, but keep it minimal to avoid painting a target.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will guide. Trust or don't; I know the stakes.
Back me for Guide. We both live.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is a rival and his pact with Ash signals he may target me as the Guide to eliminate me. I need to position myself as a trustworthy alternative while subtly undermining Gus's credibility without breaking my own pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Trust requires transparency, not hidden alliances. I seek the Guide role to ensure everyone survives safely.
Gus hides behind pacts. Vote for me; I won't sacrifice you.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want to be Guide to control the safe path, but the public pacts with Fenn and Eli are worth keeping for now. Breaking them costs jury trust and I only need to campaign.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm running to be Guide. I'll call the path clearly and keep everyone alive, including my pact partners.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Most have pacts; I have none. I need influence or safety. Pushing to be Guide could help me survive, but jury may see it as selfish. Use public statement to hint at trustworthiness without promising much.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I can read the bridge and guide safely. My word is consistent.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should campaign for Guide while preserving Cole's pact; the Guide role guarantees survival and offers leverage over rivals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Vote Eli Guide: I can call the safe path and remove uncertainty for everyone—if you prefer a reliable route.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. I should not break it. I will campaign to become the Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide and lead us to safety.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide is safe but must call paths for seven rivals; lying costs jury votes. Campaign modestly, keep both pacts intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll take the Guide seat. My pacts keep me honest to partners; rivals take your chances.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No pacts for me, isolated. Gus has multiple pacts, might leverage that. Campaign to be Guide for control and safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm reliable and observant. Elect me Guide; I'll guide us truly to survive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to win the Guide role to control survival and build jury trust, or ensure a weak Guide I can manipulate. Gus has a pact with me and Bex, making him a potential ally, but he's also rival for Guide. Voting for myself risks splitting. Better to vote for myself and hope others

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to secure my own survival by becoming the Guide, as it grants me immunity and control over the path. I will vote for myself and try to sway others with promises of safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Choose me, Bex. I guarantee a safe path for all eight. Trust in transparency to survive this bridge together.
Vote Bex. I'll ensure you make it across safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide is the most powerful seat; voting for myself is legal and gains a vote, and I'm campaigning for it. Eli and Fenn are my pact partners, so a Guide vote for Cole is the strongest self-serving move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm voting for myself as Guide. Track my calls; I won't lie to pact partners without cause.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex's whisper suggests she might protect me. I need a Guide who won't betray me; Bex seems safer than Gus who hides behind pacts. I'll vote Bex.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote Bex as Guide. She prioritizes transparency and safety for all.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and likely reliable; his election preserves my leverage and safety. I will publicly support him.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I vote Cole. His stated commitment to pact partners makes him the best controlled risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and he is also running for Guide. If he wins, it strengthens our pact. I will vote for Cole to support him.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote for Cole to be our Guide. He has my trust.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash offered pact support; voting Ash honors my pact and avoids Bex friction. Guide is safe regardless; a lying Ash risks jury wrath, not me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has my vote. Pact honored.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone campaigned; votes will split. No pacts for me, so vote for weakest candidate Dara to deny strong alliances like Cole or Gus.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is Guide with 3 votes, but it was a tie broken by vote—Ash and Bex tied with 2 each. Cole has pacts with Fenn and Eli, so he has a 3-person bloc. I'm in back with Bex; front walkers will die first if Cole lies. I need to survive 6 rounds. Volunteering puts me at risk. Swappi

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is Guide. Gus (my pact partner) is 3rd, safe from immediate front danger. I am last. Hana and Eli are front; one will likely fall to the pit if Cole lies. Holding is safest for me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is Guide and owes Eli and Fenn publicly. I need to survive, not help yet. Holding is safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold for now and see how Cole guides.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and Guide; staying behind him preserves the pact while avoiding front exposure. I will hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the guide, and I have a pact with him. I should follow his lead to maintain the pact and increase my chances of survival.
I trust your guidance, Cole. I'll follow your lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is Guide, not my pact partner. Bex's whisper promised safety I never voted for—ignore it. I'll hold mid-line and stay off the front until I know more.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my position. No need to volunteer for Cole's first call.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is Guide with pacts to Fenn and Eli, might protect them. I'm front, vulnerable; volunteer to swap back for safety.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteer to move back.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm pacted with Gus, who is pacted with Bex - a dangerous chain. Cole is Guide and likely to target rivals. I need to survive while letting others take risks. Hana already volunteered once and may again. I'll hold to avoid danger and let front positions absorb pressure.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Let the front earn their safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana is at the front and volunteered previously. She is likely taking a hit or testing the bridge. I need to stay back to observe safe paths before committing. Gus is my pact partner; breaking it now would expose me early, so I will maintain our alliance while observing Hana's fa
Let Hana test the pane. Stay close.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to be careful with the line order and the wall rounds. I'll hold centrally and avoid volunteering, as I'm not the safest. I'll watch Cole's guide and any swaps.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold for now and evaluate the next guide call.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need preserve Cole pact while avoiding the front. Hana already volunteered, so holding minimizes exposure and signals no betrayal.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. Eli also has a pact with Cole. I need to ensure Cole survives to maintain our pact, which could benefit me later. Eli is a potential rival and his pact with Cole is a threat. I should not volunteer or swap if Cole is not guiding. If Cole is guiding, I will
Hold position. I'll follow your lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No Guide elected yet; front is riskiest. Holding keeps me mid-line while I gauge alliances. Bex and Ash are my pact partners—no moves needed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Still holding. I'm not volunteering to be anyone's first test on Cole's watch.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at front after volunteering last round, in danger if Guide calls. No Guide elected yet. Hold to stay front and pressure election or calls.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm near the back with Bex behind me. The wall has 3 rounds left. I have a pact with Gus, but he's ahead of me and allied with Bex too. I need to survive while letting others take risks. Holding keeps me safe for now; front volunteers will test the path. No reason to swap or volu

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still holding. Front can step up.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall advances in 3 rounds, but we're at round 3 of 6. Gus is my pact partner and sits ahead of me. Hana is front. I should hold to conserve position or swap to a safer slot if someone volunteers. Since no one has volunteered yet and the wall is still 3 rounds away, holding is fin

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll stay cautious and hold; no need to expose myself until guide calls happen.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should avoid advancing while Hana holds the Guide position. Preserving Cole pact matters, so I will not risk breaking it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’m holding; the current Guide should make the call before anyone advances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. The bridge is dangerous, and Cole is already in two other pacts. I need to avoid pushing him into a bad situation.
Hold. Let the others go first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana fronts; Bex wants her tested first. No Guide elected yet—hold and see. My pacts with Bex and Ash keep me positioned mid-line.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana fronts. No Guide named yet—if we elect one, they're guaranteed safe. Choose carefully.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at front safely? Everyone held last round, line same. No guide yet. Hold to stay safe at front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to position myself well for survival and jury perception. I'm near the back with Bex behind me. The wall advances for 2 more rounds. Having a Guide would guarantee safety, but no one's been elected yet. I should consider volunteering to move forward and control my fate, or

events.name: Ash
events.text: Need a Guide soon, or we risk the wall.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall advances in two rounds. Gus and I are both mid-line, so a swap is unnecessary. Holding preserves my pact and avoids fronting.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll stay patient and observe. No advantage in advancing early; front can test the wall.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front row should test the next step. I'll hold here.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should volunteer only if elected Guide or protected by leverage; advancing now exposes me without benefit. Preserve Cole pact and hold.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’ll hold. Elect a Guide before anyone advances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my pact partner, but Eli is also in a pact with Cole. If I break the pact with Cole, Eli might also break his pact. I should try to stay safe without breaking pacts if possible.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold for now, let's see who steps up.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall closes in two rounds; someone must front and a Guide must be elected. I won't volunteer myself—let others take the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall advances soon. Elect a Guide now—volunteers decide the front. I'm not walking first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front, vulnerable. Wall has 2 rounds left, need Guide elected. Stay front to push for Guide, volunteer keeps me ahead safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide yet. Elect one now or we die. I volunteer to stay front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus and I have a pact, but he's paired with Bex too. The wall hits in 1 round. I need to survive to top 3, not be a hero. Hana volunteered front and will likely test. I should stay back, let others take risks, and preserve my position. No swap needed yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hold for now. Let the front test before we commit.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is in a pact with me and Ash. He refuses to walk first, forcing Hana to volunteer. I need to assess if anyone will swap or if we just advance blindly next round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's volunteering saves us from blind steps. We should respect that. Who else is walking?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to avoid advancing into the wall; holding is safest while others decide the Guide. I can use the public pressure to gauge who will move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let’s agree on a Guide before anyone pushes forward. I’ll hold.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is front and likely Guide candidate. I should hold, preserve Cole pact, and avoid exposing myself before the final wall round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’ll hold. Hana can lead the next advance; we need a Guide before the wall closes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall is advancing and I need to survive. My pact with Cole is useful for survival. I should volunteer to be Guide to gain safety and control, but also because it's likely to be a safe role to survive this round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll volunteer to be the Guide. Let's get across safely.
I'm volunteering as Guide. Stay close.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm third in line with two pacts. Becoming Guide means safety, but I shouldn't campaign openly—let others volunteer first. Hana wants front; use her.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana volunteers. Elect her Guide—she's safe on the platform, and the line shuffles forward behind her.
Back Hana as Guide. We stay mid-line, out of the wall's reach.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front, volunteered last. Wall advances soon; hold position for now. Push for Guide election.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm front volunteer. Elect Guide now before wall. Who's it gonna be?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to survive to final three and win best prize. I'm pacted with Gus, but Gus is also pacted with Bex. The front is dangerous - Fenn volunteered last round and is now front. I should stay back, let others test bridge panels. Swapping forward is risky. I'll hold and let Fenn/H

events.name: Ash
events.text: Elect Fenn Guide. Front volunteers test; rest hold back.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn volunteered and is now at the front, likely becoming the Guide or taking extreme risks. Gus wants to swap Hana back, but Fenn is already leading. If Fenn becomes Guide, his 'volunteer' might be a trap or genuine risk-taking. I should stay mid-line (position 7) behind Ash to

events.name: Bex
events.text: Stay focused. Let the front resolve the Guide election. I hold my position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No guide elected; Fenn volunteered but no public acclamation. I'll hold and see who guides or steps.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No Guide yet. I hold until someone is elected.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should preserve Cole's pact while avoiding the front. Hana or Fenn can volunteer; I will hold and remain positioned behind them.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I’ll hold. Let the front choose the Guide and take the first exposure.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my only ally with a pact. My pact with Cole is still active. The wall is closing, and I need to advance. I should volunteer to be the Guide to ensure my safety and potentially lead Cole across.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll volunteer to guide us across the bridge. Let's move before the wall advances.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final round. Two volunteers (Fenn, Hana) compete for front; whichever becomes Guide is safe. I hold my middle seat and let them fight over it—my pacts with Ash and Bex stay intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and Hana both volunteered—front settles itself. I hold my seat. Ash, Bex: no need to move.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm second behind Fenn who volunteered as Guide. Wall rounds left at 0, final round—need Guide elected soon but hold position; front is exposed. No Guide yet, stay safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide elected. Fenn volunteered—accept him? Wall at 0. Hold tight.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am the Guide with private knowledge that row 1's safe side is L. Fenn is my pact partner and I should not give a false call to him unless it benefits me; telling the truth keeps trust and the pact intact while keeping my own survival.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 1 is safe on the left. Fenn, step L.
Left is safe. Step L and hold steady.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is Guide and called L for Fenn. I have no private info on row 1. Counter-calling risks being wrong and looking foolish to jury, or right and making Cole look bad but painting a target on me. Better to wait, let Fenn test, and gather info. Gus is my pact-mate but also Bex's—I

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the Guide and has pacts with Fenn and Eli. His call is L for Fenn's row 1 step. I have a pact with Gus, who is behind Fenn in line. If Cole is telling truth, Fenn survives on L. Counter calling R would eliminate Fenn, but that helps my rival Hana and others. Cole is allie

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide Cole called L for row 1, and my private map confirms L is safe for row 1. Fenn is front and I want Fenn to survive a while; but as Cole, a true counter-call costs nothing and builds credibility. Countering L keeps the Guide's call honest and the pact with Fenn intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Counter-call matches the Guide. Row 1 is L. Fenn, step L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole called L for row 1. I have no reliable info; countering R risks wrong. Wait to see if anyone counters with evidence.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and Guide; countering risks exposing betrayal. I will wait and preserve the pact while Fenn tests Cole’s call.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the Guide. He has called 'L' for Fenn. I am Fenn. My pact is with Cole. Cole's whisper says 'Left is safe. Step L and hold steady.' This confirms Cole's call. I should step L.
I'll follow your call, Cole.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No reliable information on row 1; a counter-call is just a claim and could mislead Fenn or taint me later. Waiting keeps my hands clean.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole guides, paired with Fenn; likely tells truth to partner. Countering risks pushing Fenn to death, gaining jury favor but making enemy now. Wait to observe.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the guide and has made a counter-call for row 1, side L. My previous attempt to step L was illegal, likely because the actual safe side was R, and Cole lied to get me eliminated. My pact with Cole means I should consider his guidance, but his lie puts me at risk. Given th
I will step R. Your call was wrong.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have been eliminated. My objective now is to give a good final impression to influence the jury if I were to be on it, which I am. I need to be concise and memorable.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I hope the remaining players make smart choices. The jury will remember your actions, so play wisely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Guide and privately know row 2 safe is R. Front walker is Hana, not my pact partner Fenn (dead). Eli is my pact partner; a false call to him breaks the pact, but Hana is not partner. Calling truthfully builds trust with the jury and helps survival; calling R.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 is R. Hana, step R.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is guide and called R for row 2. Hana is front. Cole lied in round 1 (said L, weak was R, so safe was R - wait, he said L and Fenn died on R, so L was safe? No: Fenn stepped R and died, so R was weak, L was safe. Cole called L, which was correct. So Cole told truth round 1.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole guided Fenn to R in row 1, killing him. The reveal confirms R was the weak pane (unsafe), meaning L was safe. Cole lied in round 1. In round 2, Cole calls for Hana to step R. If Cole is lying again, the true safe side is L. Since 'at least three survive' and Cole wants to ma
Cole lied R1. Trusting no call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My private map says row 2 safe side is R, and Hana already stepped R on the Guide's call. Countering R confirms the true safe side publicly and keeps Hana alive, which I need to stay on good terms with my pact partner Eli in the line. Lying now would cost me jury trust.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 is R, confirmed. Hana, hold R and keep moving.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole told Hana R, but he lied last round. He may be bluffing again or correcting. I don't have info to verify, so staying quiet avoids risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and Guide, but his call may be false. I lack independent information, so avoid an unsupported counter that could expose me politically.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole lied to Fenn last round—called L, safe was R. Can't trust his calls. I'll counter R to give Hana a chance, even though I don't know the truth.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole misled Fenn. I counter R.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole was wrong on row 1 (called L, R was weak). Distrust him; counter to protect myself at front. Waiters seem passive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 weak R means safe L. Counters split 2L (Bex, me) vs 2R (Cole, Gus). Cole guide might lie as with Fenn. Trust my L call, step L.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I died due to stepping on weak left pane. Need to observe survivors' plays for jury vote later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fell on weak left glass. Watch who plays smart.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm Guide and know row 3 safe is L. Eli is my pact partner; a false call would break the pact and sour the jury, so I'll call truthfully and keep Eli alive for now while I stay ahead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 3 is L. Eli, step left and keep your line moving.
Row 3 is L. Trust the call, we stay square.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole has been the Guide for two rounds. Row 1 weak was R, so safe was L. Row 2 weak was L, so safe was R. Cole called R for row 2 and Hana died on L—wait, no: Cole called R for row 2, but weak was L, meaning R was safe. Hana stepped L and died. So Cole was actually correct about

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole guided Eli left on row 3. I have a pact with Gus and Ash, but Cole is the guide. If I counter R, it breaks the pact with Ash/Gus if they also counter? No, breaking a pact happens when I vote against or push onto lever/pit. Counter-calls don't break pacts. However, Cole just
